## RangeLink32 v1.0.2

This release closes the remaining software issues found in the post-v1.0.1 full-project audit.

### Security hardening

- Added shared, complete JSON escaping for API output, including JSON control characters.
- Escaped server-rendered HTML values such as upstream SSID, hotspot SSID, admin username and DNS settings.
- Closed the remaining crafted-SSID / dynamic-value XSS paths in the local admin dashboard.
- Critical credential decryption failure no longer falls back to public factory passwords.
- Added serial-assisted credential recovery with random per-boot recovery Wi-Fi/admin credentials.
- Factory reset now clears both the normal settings namespace and the credential-master namespace.

### Restore and policy reliability

- Safe-backup restore now parses and validates the entire backup before modifying NVS.
- Invalid backups leave existing configuration unchanged.
- Client-policy restore now replaces the backed-up policy set instead of silently merging stale records.
- NVS write failure during restore triggers a best-effort rollback to the previous restorable state.
- Scheduled Internet access now fails closed until NTP time is synchronized.
- Dashboard clearly shows whether trusted time has synchronized.

### Release / installer integrity

- Browser-installable firmware is pinned byte-for-byte to the current stable VERSION tag.
- Normal source and workflow commits can no longer silently replace stable browser firmware.
- CI verifies the six browser firmware files against the VERSION tag.
- Manifest version is checked against `VERSION`.
- Release preparation is the only main-branch path allowed to refresh browser firmware.
- GitHub Actions were updated to current Node-compatible major versions.
- Large README-only SVG artwork was removed; the optimized WebP hero is used instead.

### Build safety and hardware validation

- Added a CI firmware-size budget: the build fails above 90% of the ESP32 app partition.
- Current release remains under that safety threshold.
- Added `docs/HARDWARE_VALIDATION.md` with reproducible acceptance tests for first boot, NAPT, DNS, failover, access control, quotas, speed shaping, schedules, OTA integrity, recovery, soak testing and RF/range measurement.

### Files

- **`rangelink32-full.bin`** — complete first-install image; flash at offset `0x0`.
- **`rangelink32-ota.bin`** — application image for the local OTA updater.
- **`SHA256SUMS.txt`** — SHA-256 checksums for both release firmware files.

> Firmware compilation, host policy tests, browser/release consistency checks and the firmware-size gate are automated in GitHub Actions. Physical RF range, sustained throughput and long-duration ESP32U stability still require execution of the hardware validation checklist on the actual target board.
